reviews.review_description:
Where is the code it launches from my iPhone to the Meta quest three but I can’t find the code. I have a year subscription.
No one can give an answer. I’m gonna have to go and leave this app alone. I was really hoping it would work, but no one’s answer this and my free time is running out May 1 and I haven’t got to experience it yet wow.

developer_response.body:
Hello chefrob21,

We’re sorry to hear that you’re having trouble find a code to connect with your iPhone.

To connect your iPhone with the Meta Quest 3, please make sure you have the MUA app installed in your iPhone.

You can search for “무아 – MUA” in the App Store to find it. You can also download it directly using the link below: https://apps.apple.com/kr/app/%EB%AC%B4%EC%95%84-mua/id6757996493 

Once installed, you’ll be able to find the connection code within the MUA app on your iPhone. Please enter this code in your VR MUA app to complete the pairing process.

Please also note that you can enjoy MUA even without pairing it with a wearable device or your phone.

Please also refer to the link below for guidance:
https://www.meta.com/ko-kr/experiences/app/developer-post/3000914650110138/

Thank you
Team MUA

reviews.review_title: I Discovered a Whole New World
reviews.review_description:
Honestly, I had never really meditated before.
I always heard that “meditation is great”, but every time I tried, I just couldn’t focus.
But the moment I launched MUA, everything changed.
The boundary between reality and the virtual world blurred, and before I knew it,
I had completely sunk into a state of deep tranquility.
The Solfeggio frequencies resonated deep within me,
and visually, I was surrounded by a breathtakingly beautiful space.
Highly recommended! You NEED to try this!

I didn't expect too much, but when I used it, it was very nice. I felt relaxed. I actually felt a little sleepy while I was meditating, and it was a very pleasant experience. If you're looking for an app that you can do before you go to bed, it would be a good choice.
The presentation and graphics are superior to other meditation apps.
